reason: Barter deals already land in my DMs and I'm fine taking a free meal for a reel. I'd maybe try the free first counted collab, but I don't see myself paying for Auto-DM when I barely ask for cash anyway.
objection: Why pay ₹499 a year when barter comes to me for free? And will a café owner actually bother making customers show a coupon at the counter? If they don't, my 'customers I brought' record stays empty.
would_change_my_mind: If the free collab showed real counted customers and a business actually paid me cash because of that record, ₹499 would feel like nothing.
